meta.title: Rex Cinema Tech — Movie Tickets & Cinema Bookings
meta.description: Browse the latest movies, choose your seats and book cinema tickets online — no account required. Available in English and Arabic.

home.heroTitle: Your story starts in the dark
home.heroSubtitle: Blockbusters, timeless classics and premium formats. Book your seat in seconds — no account needed.

home.formatsSubtitle: Premium formats for every kind of movie night.
home.cinemaInfoText: Three locations, nine screens and every premium format — find your nearest cinema and make a night of it.
home.ctaText: Pick a movie, choose your seats and pay in under two minutes.
